requirements.requirement: The system must map each clinical trial recruitment status value to a predefined numeric score using the schema defined in EVAL-CT-STATUS-001.
The system must assign the highest score to trials with status RECRUITING.
The system must assign a lower score to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING than RECRUITING.
The system must assign lower scores to COMPLETED and TERMINATED statuses than to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING.
The system must assign the lowest score to UNKNOWN or missing status values.
The system must produce a normalized score within a fixed range defined by the schema (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must ensure that identical input status values always produce identical scores (deterministic behavior).
The system must compute a score for every trial object returned by clinical_trials_service that includes a status field.
The system must not alter or overwrite the original status field when computing the score.
The system must attach the computed status score as a new attribute in the trial data structure.
The system must handle unexpected or unmapped status values by assigning the UNKNOWN score without throwing an error.
The system must handle null or missing status fields by assigning the UNKNOWN score.
The system must process multiple trials in a single request and compute scores independently for each trial.
The system must complete score computation without introducing breaking changes to existing RECRUITING filter behavior in clinical_trials_service.
The system must ensure score computation executes within existing service performance constraints for batch trial processing.
